title: Spot
description: Versioned spot configuration. Fields owned by provider-mapping and site-survey issues (NOAA tide station, NWS grid mapping, shore bearing, accepted/prohibited wind sectors) are optional here and must be listed in `unresolved` until validated.

version.description: Configuration revision for this spot document, distinct from schemaVersion.

village.description: Postal village or locality within the municipality, when the spot is known by a sub-municipal name.

location.description: General spot location. latitude/longitude are optional until validated against an authoritative source; timezone is required.

datum.description: Geodetic datum for the coordinate pair, e.g. 'NAD83' or 'WGS84'.

launchPoint.description: Representative beach/launch coordinate, distinct from the spot's general location point.

datum.description: Geodetic datum for the coordinate pair, e.g. 'NAD83' or 'WGS84'.

shore.description: Site-survey data defining beach orientation and safe wind sectors. All three fields must be present for a spot to be VALIDATED.

seawardBearingDegrees.description: Compass bearing (degrees true, clockwise from north) pointing from the beach toward open water. Used as the reference direction for wind classification. An onshore wind is one whose meteorological FROM-direction matches this bearing.

acceptedWindSectors.description: Wind sectors in which the spot is considered safe and kite-able. Must cover all accepted classifications (DIRECT_ONSHORE and SIDE_ONSHORE).

prohibitedWindSectors.description: Wind sectors that are prohibited or not accepted. When a wind sector's startDegrees > endDegrees the sector wraps through 0°/360° (e.g. startDegrees:330, endDegrees:60 covers 330°–360° and 0°–60°).

sources.description: Provider mappings for weather and tide data. Each sub-field is owned by a provider-adapter issue and absent until that issue resolves it.

nwsGridpoint.description: NWS grid-point metadata resolved from the Points API for this spot's coordinates. Owned by issue #4.

office.description: NWS CWA (County Warning Area) office identifier, e.g. 'BOX'.

pointType.description: NWS point type returned by the Points API ('land' or 'marine').

forecastEndpoint.description: Full URL for the NWS 12-hourly forecast endpoint.

forecastHourlyEndpoint.description: Full URL for the NWS hourly forecast endpoint.

forecastGridDataEndpoint.description: Full URL for the NWS grid data endpoint (provides wind direction in degrees and gust values).

radarStation.description: NEXRAD radar station identifier for the grid cell, e.g. 'KBOX'.

attribution.description: Human-readable attribution required when displaying NWS data.

active.description: Must be false until all required safety-critical fields (shore bearing, wind sectors, provider mappings) are validated.

noaaTideStation.description: NOAA CO-OPS tide station used for tide predictions at this spot.

stationType.description: 'H' = harmonic (reference) station with its own tidal constituents; 'S' = subordinate station using offset-adjusted predictions from a reference station.

referenceStationId.description: NOAA CO-OPS ID of the harmonic reference station. Required when stationType is 'S'.

datum.description: Tidal datum for height values returned by the predictions API (e.g. 'MLLW').

distanceKm.description: Great-circle distance in kilometres from the spot's general location.

availableProducts.description: NOAA CO-OPS product identifiers confirmed available for this station (e.g. 'predictions').

noaaTideStationFallback.description: Policy for handling NOAA CO-OPS station retrieval failures.

stations.description: Ordered list of alternative stations to try, in preference order.

onAllFailed.description: Action taken when all stations fail. 'NO_GO' — do not publish a forecast; surface an explicit error to the user.

windSector.description: A contiguous arc of wind directions sharing the same safety classification. Arcs are expressed in meteorological FROM-degrees (0° = north, 90° = east). When startDegrees > endDegrees, the arc wraps through 0°/360° (e.g. startDegrees:330, endDegrees:60 covers the north-through-northeast arc).

startDegrees.description: Inclusive start of the arc in degrees true. When startDegrees > endDegrees, the arc wraps through 0°/360°.

endDegrees.description: Exclusive end of the arc in degrees true.

classification.description: Wind classification relative to the spot's seawardBearingDegrees. DIRECT_ONSHORE: |diff| ≤ 30°. SIDE_ONSHORE: 30° < |diff| ≤ 75°. CROSS_SHORE: 75° < |diff| ≤ 90°. SIDE_OFFSHORE: 90° < |diff| ≤ 135°. OFFSHORE: |diff| > 135°.

accepted.description: True when this sector is safe and kite-able at this spot.
